subject: Verreaux's eagle
title: An Eagle the Weight of a Cat Is Killing Baboons Five Times Heavier

scenes.text: This eagle weighs about as much as a house cat. Its prey is the size of a child.
Verreaux's eagles weigh three to four and a half kilos. No raptor was known to kill a primate over 13.
Then, in Chad's Ennedi desert, researchers found baboon skulls with talon holes punched through.
One adult male weighed about 22 kilos.
Baboons there scream and dive for cover when this eagle appears. Other raptors, they ignore.
Early humans this size were thought to be safe from eagles. Maybe they weren't.

description:
An eagle that weighs about as much as a house cat is killing adult baboons in the Sahara.
In Chad's Ennedi plateau, researchers found skulls of adult male baboons with talon punctures, and shoulder bones raked by claws. One victim weighed about 22 kg; no primate over 13 kg had been confirmed killed by a raptor before. Verreaux's eagles weigh about 3 to 4.5 kg. The baboons alarm-call and dive for cover when one appears. The study was published in the American Journal of Biological Anthropology in November 2026.
Could eagles have hunted early humans too?
first_comment: Verreaux's eagles often hunt in pairs, one distracting the prey while the other strikes. Which animal punches furthest above its weight?
